basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old amateur baker from Quebec, Canada. I've been exploring baking as a hobby for the past two years, especially focusing on budget-friendly recipes. I'm also into racing games and have a keen interest in personal finance, trying to make the most out of every dollar. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, where I serve as a customer service representative. I'm married and enjoy spending weekends trying out new recipes or playing games with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My baking knowledge is mostly self-taught through trial and error, and online resources. I frequently consult baking forums and watch tutorial videos. My interest in personal finance comes from managing my own expenses and following financial advice from various online communities.
